text: I withdraw this acceptance because I counted an assembled specialization as an existing [rank-three Check](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/4f7a4021c5eefb6a254dcd4db450663a5f1aa71d/TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/LieHighestWeight/README.md#L1186). The published type-B generator relations and rational-base Cartan comparison are sound, but I have not found a source-present B₃/C₃ example combining the concrete base.cartanMatrix eigenvalues and higher exponents. The surjection remains mathematically consistent with the Serre construction; the missing required Check means I should withhold acceptance.

I withdraw this acceptance because I marked the full [dyadic form table](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/4f7a4021c5eefb6a254dcd4db450663a5f1aa71d/TauCetiRoadmap/QuadraticFormInvariants/README.md#L2658) checked although part was inferred from general formulas. The [published fixture](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/d96e9ceca01f4548b817649c5ae95e33c6fc3ae4/TauCeti/NumberTheory/LocalField/QuadraticForm/StiefelWhitney/PadicTwo.lean#L78) proves the line w₁ table and repeated-binary w₂ table. I have not located the complete requested binary w₁/w₂ table, including the leading-one forms, as source-present calculations. The Hasse–Stiefel–Whitney identity remains mathematically consistent; the incomplete source Checks require withholding acceptance.

I withdraw this acceptance because I described the Cauchy guardrail as a published passing Check. The source proves Cauchy nonintegrability and general moment-transfer results separately; I have not located the required source-present calculation that the Cauchy law lies in its own finite-W₂ component but outside P₂. That distinction is explicitly required by the [roadmap](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/4f7a4021c5eefb6a254dcd4db450663a5f1aa71d/TauCetiRoadmap/OptimalTransport/README.md#L510). The component definition remains mathematically sound. This corrects the claimed evidence; it is not a counterexample.
